summary_1line: Pandava and Kaurava forces clash fiercely as Drona battles Dhrishtadyumna and then duels Satyaki in a spectacular exchange of arrows and celestial weapons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dhrishtadyumna leaps onto Drona’s chariot, running across the yoke and the backs of the red steeds while striking with sword and shield.
Drona and Satyaki stand on their chariots firing torrents of arrows that darken the sky until the sun disappears behind the storm of shafts.
The battlefield lies strewn with severed heads, golden armor soaked in blood, and circling vultures while warriors continue fighting amid the carnage.
